ev.q: The epidemiologic and clinical features of 12 angiostrongyliasis cases in the continental United States were analyzed.
The most frequently reported symptoms were subjective fever, generalized weakness, headache, and numbness/tingling.
The 16 patient specimens were submitted from eight states, including six from California, four from Texas

methods_quotes.q: A presumptive case was defined as detection of A. cantonensis DNA by PCR testing of a clinical CSF specimen
A confirmed case was a presumptive case with health care provider documentation of clinically compatible disease.
